listing.name: Super Smash Bros. (Smash Bros. Recompiled)
listing.summary: A Windows and Linux port of the original Super Smash Bros. Set it up with your own US Nintendo 64 game file.

steps.title: Prepare the game
steps.instruction: Keep the complete package for your system together. On Windows, install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x64) if needed. Open the player (SmashBrosRecompiled.exe on Windows), choose Load ROM and select your own 16 MiB, big-endian Super Smash Bros. USA .z64 (SHA-1 e2929e10fccc0aa84e5776227e798abc07cedabf). Choose Start Game.

warnings: Keep the profile that contains your SRAM and settings. Changing portable mode does not move existing data.
The package includes Chiaro fonts by Fontworks that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.

references.title: Setup instructions for the inspected release

data_locations: %LOCALAPPDATA%/SmashBrosRecompiled by default, or the game folder if it already uses portable.txt
